SplitRecipient.description:
Recipient of an on-chain revenue split. The identity binds to an `$EPM`
via CHAIN_PROOFS so a payout address is provably the recipient's.

EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of the recipient's Entity Profile Message (`$EPM`)

ADDRESS.description: On-chain payout address (EVM 0x / SOL base58 / BTC address)

XPUB.description: Account xpub the address derives from

SCX.description:
Chain Settlement / Smart-Contract Descriptor. The forward description of the
exact established splitter contract/program a buyer's wallet targets so
payment and platform commission settle atomically on-chain. Referenced by
`$CMT.CONTRACTS` and echoed into a store `checkout` quote. Commission is
realized by the splitter contract itself when the buyer pays it; there is no
off-chain or manual settlement step.

SPLITTER_STANDARD.description:
Established split standard id, e.g. "0xsplits.v2" (ETH) or the SOL
splitter program name. An audited off-the-shelf standard, not a custom
contract.

SPLITTER_ADDRESS.description:
Deployed splitter contract address (ETH) or splitter program id (SOL) the
buyer's payment routes into

SPLIT_CONFIG_ID.description:
The specific split configuration (recipient set + basis points) registered
with the splitter

TOKEN_ADDRESS.description: ERC-20 / SPL mint address for stablecoin settlement; empty = native asset

SPLIT_RECIPIENTS.description:
The recipient set the split configuration encodes (platform + publisher…),
mirrored here for independent verification

MIN_CONFIRMATIONS.description: Confirmations required before the payment is accepted

MEMO_SCHEME.description: How the order reference is bound on-chain for replay-safe matching

RevenueSplit.description: One recipient's share of a sale, expressed in basis points.

BPS.description:
Share in basis points (1/100 of a percent); all splits plus the platform
commission sum to 10000

CMT.description:
Commission Terms / Revenue Split. Binds a listing, store, or publisher to a
platform commission and the on-chain split that enforces it. This record
makes "the platform earns on every transaction" auditable and portable
across store deployments. Commission is realized purely by the buyer's
payment routing through the on-chain splitter contract described in
CONTRACTS — never by a manual or off-chain settlement step.

TARGET_ID.description: The `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / store id / publisher xpub the terms apply to

SPLITS.description: Recipient splits; each in basis points, summing with the commission to 10000

PLATFORM_RECIPIENT.description: The platform's per-chain payout identity (the commission recipient)

ENFORCEMENT.description: How the split is enforced (on-chain splitter vs provider-attested)

CONTRACTS.description:
The established splitter contract(s)/program(s) that perform the split,
one per accepted chain/asset

EFFECTIVE_AT.description: Unix ms when these terms take effect

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix ms when these terms expire, or 0 for no expiry

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature by the store operator `$EPM`

STOModuleRef.description: Reference to the store module that runs a store.

CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash of the (encrypted) store module artifact

OPERATOR_EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of the store operator's `$EPM`

STORE_MODULE.description: The (encrypted) store MODULE that runs this store

APP_ID.description: Optional `$APP.ID` when the store ships a UI app

IS_OFFICIAL.description:
True only for the platform-signed official store, verifiable against the
platform's well-known signing key

COMMISSION_TERMS_ID.description: Alternative reference to store-default terms by `$CMT.TERMS_ID`

ACCEPTED_CHAINS.description: Chains/tokens this store accepts, each with its splitter settlement

CATALOG_ROOT_CID.description: IPFS CID of the store's catalog (a `$REC` of `$PLG`/`$STF` listings)

PROTOCOL_ID.description: libp2p protocol id the store answers on
